name: Update Deal
description: Update a deal in HubSpot by id. Set **Object ID** and put the fields to change in **Object Properties** as HubSpot internal names. Look up the id with **Search CRM** if you only have a name. Example: Object ID `123`, Object Properties `{ "dealstage": "closedwon", "amount": "90000" }`. Returns the updated deal. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/beta-docs/guides/api/crm/objects/deals#update-deals)
